definitions.gloss: anti-nuclear power; opposition to nuclear plants
definitions.explanation: Opposition to nuclear power generation and nuclear power plants. Used mostly before another noun, for movements, protests and people.

examples.japanese: {反原発|はんげんぱつ}⟦デモ→デモ：19416_demo⟧。
{反原発|はんげんぱつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{運動|うんどう}→運動：00821_undou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がった→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧。

⟦{原発|げんぱつ}→原発：11943_genpatsu⟧⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧、{反原発|はんげんぱつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{訴|うった}える→訴える：01891_uttaeru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えた→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: After the nuclear accident, more people spoke out against nuclear power.

notes:
⟦{反|はん}→反〜：03964_han⟧ (anti-) + ⟦{原発|げんぱつ}→原発：11943_genpatsu⟧ (nuclear power plant). It is about nuclear power, not nuclear weapons.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {反原発|はんげんぱつ}⟦デモ→デモ：19416_demo⟧: anti-nuclear demonstration
- {反原発|はんげんぱつ}⟦{運動|うんどう}→運動：00821_undou⟧: anti-nuclear movement
- {反原発|はんげんぱつ}⟦{派|は}→派：28356_ha⟧: opponents of nuclear power

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{原発|げんぱつ}→原発：11943_genpatsu⟧: nuclear power plant
- ⟦{脱原発|だつげんぱつ}→脱原発：33033_datsugenpatsu⟧: phasing out nuclear power
- {反核|はんかく}: opposition to nuclear weapons
